column1: # Outcome of every test file of Thunderbird's OpenPGP tests in the job
# derives it: test, outcome with Mozilla's librnp (control), outcome with
# the Octopus. Separated by tabs, sorted by path. The job fails if a run
# differs from this table in any line.
# container, headless. Octopus: branch `pqc` after work package C1, feature
# crypto-openssl. Recorded from run 45934898368 (2026-11-27). Changed since:
# browser_upload.js, fail to pass with the Octopus, with work package C2
# (the Octopus ends the lines of ASCII Armor with CR LF, as RNP does);
# test_secretKeys.js, fail to pass with the Octopus, with work package W2
# (v6 keys have a keygrip, so Thunderbird sees them and refuses them).
# A line changes only together with the change that causes it, and the
# commit message says why. Nothing is removed from the test run to make a
# line pass. What is known about the lines that are not "pass pass":
# test_pqcSubkey.js: skipped by its manifest (run-if nightly_build).
# browser_keyWizard.js: skipped by its manifest (not headless, not Linux).
# browser_keyAssistantCopyLink.js: fails with Mozilla's librnp as well
#   ("resolve button should be shown" times out), so not caused by the
#   should load for rc-openpgp-aead.eml" times out.
